    The six-lift and eight-lift trees of Appendix C.1 #

    eq:six-lift-tree with the lifts eq:six-lift-coordinates, and eq:eight-lift-tree with the lifts eq:eight-lift-coordinates (local-ray-restrictions.tex). Each is given as a table poset with its rays; the factorization checks of lem:tree-quotient enter only through the retraction conditions on cover relations (Lemma 8.9), as hypotheses X*/Y* naming the excluded factorizations. Lemma 8.8 then excludes both trees.
